Mobiel 21 is a Belgian social-profit organisation, committed to making sustainable mobility the easy, inclusive and attractive choice. They work locally, nationally and across Europe. Mobiel21 sets people in motion, both literally and metaphorically, by working with citizens, governments, schools and organisations to rethink how we move in and use public space.

The Lab of Thought is an independent global platform that brings together leading academics, policymakers, interest groups, and businesses to fundamentally rethink the development of our cities. Through a combination of education, experimental environments, and real-world applications, they cultivate innovative thinking and facilitate strategic knowledge exchange.
